entries.question: Maine DDT course complete ab bsc dialysis technology karna hai to konse yearly me admission milega
entries.answer:
KGMU में प्रवेश से संबंधित जानकारी के लिए आप KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) पर जाकर नवीनतम प्रवेश निर्देशों (Admission Instructions) को देख सकते हैं।

चूंकि आप डिप्लोमा (DDT) के बाद सीधे B.Sc. Dialysis Technology में प्रवेश के बारे में पूछ रहे हैं, तो यह प्रवेश प्रक्रिया विश्वविद्यालय के नियमों और कोर्स के 'लेटरल एंट्री' (Lateral Entry) प्रावधानों पर निर्भर करती है। 

मेरा सुझाव है कि आप:
1. **वेबसाइट चेक करें:** [Bachelor Admission 2026 Instructions](https://www.kgmu.org/upload_file/user_download/2207cb2a6ac52c5f5d9311d63bb6739d.pdf) को ध्यान से पढ़ें।
2. **सीधा संपर्क करें:** सटीक जानकारी के लिए आप KGMU के प्रवेश अनुभाग (Admission Cell) या संबंधित विभाग से संपर्क करें।

मैं एक AI हूँ और प्रवेश की पात्रता या वर्ष (Year) में छूट के बारे में आधिकारिक निर्णय नहीं ले सकता। कृपया आधिकारिक सूचनाओं का ही पालन करें।

entries.question: I have given a token no 2 online what to do next
entries.answer:
Since you have already generated your online token, please follow these steps:

1. **Reach the Hospital:** Ensure you arrive at the KGMU OPD (Gate 2) well before the registration counters close at **1:00 PM**. 
2. **Bring Required Documents:** Carry your original **Aadhaar card** and the mobile phone you used for the registration to receive the verification OTP. If you are coming from outside Lucknow, ensure you have a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.
3. **Registration/Verification:** Proceed to the designated counter to verify your token. You will be required to pay the **₹50 OPD registration fee** (if not already paid through the online portal).
4. **Collect Slip:** Once the payment and verification are complete, you will receive your physical OPD slip, which contains your patient ID and the assigned room number for your consultation.
5. **Consultation:** Proceed to the department room mentioned on your slip. 

**Important Notes:**
* **Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM.
* **Safety:** Please avoid sharing your personal details or OPD token information in this chat.
* **Medical Advice:** I am an AI, not a doctor. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**, which operates 24/7.

entries.question: Ok where to show token no ?
entries.answer:
Once you arrive at the KGMU OPD complex, follow these steps to show your token:

1. **Go to the Registration/Help Desk:** Upon entering through **Gate 2**, look for the main registration counters or the patient facilitation center within the OPD building.
2. **Present Your Token/Details:** Show the staff the digital token number you received (either on your phone screen or the printout).
3. **Verification:** The staff will verify your details using your mobile number and Aadhaar. They will then process your registration, collect the **₹50 OPD fee**, and issue your official physical OPD slip.
4. **Proceed to the Department:** Your physical slip will indicate the specific room number for the Gynaecology (Queen Mary’s) OPD. Take that slip directly to the assigned room to see the doctor.

If you are unsure where the specific counter is, you can ask the security personnel at Gate 2 to direct you to the "New OPD Registration" area.

entries.question: Helo sir ma'am new apointment kaise
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD के लिए ऑनलाइन अप्वाइंटमेंट लेना अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों से अप्वाइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं:

**1. ऑनलाइन माध्यम (ORS):**
*   वेबसाइट [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं।
*   'Uttar Pradesh' राज्य चुनें और फिर 'KGMU' का चयन करें।
*   'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें।
*   अपना विभाग (Department), तारीख और समय चुनें।
*   मरीज का विवरण भरें और ₹50 का शुल्क ऑनलाइन जमा करें।
*   सफल भुगतान के बाद अप्वाइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड कर लें।

**2. मोबाइल ऐप (ABHA/Health Care App):**
*   अपने मोबाइल नंबर और OTP का उपयोग करके रजिस्टर करें और ORS वाली प्रक्रिया का पालन करें।

**3. SMS द्वारा:**
*   अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <मरीज का नाम>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेजें।

**4. वॉक-इन (Walk-in):**
*   अस्पताल आकर भी आप टोकन ले सकते हैं। इसके लिए अपना आधार कार्ड और चालू मोबाइल नंबर साथ लाएं। OTP के माध्यम से पंजीकरण होगा और ₹50 का शुल्क देकर आप OPD स्लिप प्राप्त कर पाएंगे।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
*   OPD का समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
*   यदि आप लखनऊ से बाहर के मरीज हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग का वैध रेफरल पत्र (Referral Letter) जरूर साथ लाएं।
*   भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से अप्वाइंटमेंट बुक करना बेहतर रहता है।

मैं एक AI हूँ, इसलिए यदि आपको कोई गंभीर स्वास्थ्य समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU की OPD में किसी डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। कृपया चैट में अपना आधार कार्ड या अन्य कोई व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: I want to book an appointment
entries.answer:

*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Log in or register, select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department, date, and time, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as above.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed Sundays).
*   **Parchi/Ticket Counter:** Closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Helpline:** You can call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333 for assistance.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: Mareej ko dikhane ke liye number kaise lagau?
entries.answer:
KGMU mein mareej ko dikhane ke liye online ya offline appointment lena zaroori hai. Aap neeche diye gaye tareekon mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain:

1. **Online Appointment (ORS):**
   - [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login ya register karein.
   - Uttar Pradesh rajya aur KGMU hospital chunein.
   - Dept, date aur samay chunte hue patient ki jaankari bharein.
   - ₹50 ka shulk (fee) online jama karke appointment slip download kar lein.

2. **Mobile App:**
   - ABHA ya kisi bhi Health Care App ke zariye register karke upar di gayi prakriya ka palan karein.

3. **SMS dwara:**
   - Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par bhejein.

4. **Hospital mein Walk-in:**
   - Hospital aakar apna Aadhaar card aur active mobile number counter par dein.
   - OTP verify hone ke baad token lein aur ₹50 ka shulk jama karke OPD slip prapt karein.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
- OPD ka samay: Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
- Bahar ke shahron se aane wale mareejon ke paas us department ka valid referral letter hona zaroori hai.
- Parchi counter 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchein.
- Main helpline number: **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333**.

*Note: Main doctor nahi hoon, isliye medical salah ke liye kripya KGMU OPD mein doctor se sampark karein. Suraksha ke liye chat mein apni koi bhi personal jaankari (jaise mobile number ya health records) share na karein.*

entries.question: Contract staff nurse vacancy form kese fill kre
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi vacancy ke liye aavedan (apply) karne ki prakriya aam taur par niche diye gaye charno (steps) ka palan karti hai:

1. **Official Website Check Karein:** Sabse pehle KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jayein.
2. **Notice Board/Recruitment Section:** Homepage par 'Notice Board' ya 'Recruitment' tab ko dekhein. Wahan "Contractual Staff Nurse" ya "Recruitment" se sambandhit koi naya notice hai ya nahi, ye check karein.
3. **Official Notification Padhein:** Agar vacancy ka notice uplabdh hai, toh us par click karke PDF download karein. Isme form bharne ka tarika (online portal ya offline application), aakhri tarikh (last date), aur zaroori documents ki jaankari di gayi hogi.
4. **Form Fill Karein:**
    * **Online:** Agar link diya gaya hai, toh wahan register karein aur apni details bharein.
    * **Offline:** Agar offline form mangwaya gaya hai, toh PDF mein diye gaye format ka printout nikalein, use sahi se bharein aur bataye gaye pate par speed post ya personally jama karein.
5. **Helpline/PRO:** Agar aapko kisi vishesh bharti (recruitment) ke bare mein spasht jaankari nahi mil rahi hai, toh aap PRO office se sampark kar sakte hain. PRO office ka contact number [https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php) par uplabdh hai.

**Zaroori Suchna:** Kripya dhyan dein ki KGMU ki official website ke alawa kisi bhi anya website ya link par apni vyaktigat jankari (personal details) ya paise na dein. Hamesha `kgmu.org` domain ka hi upyog karein.

Filhal, mere paas staff nurse ki kisi naye vacancy ka koi live update nahi hai. Aap samay-samay par [kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) ko check karte rahein.

entries.question: Muje skin ka apartment lena h
entries.answer:
For skin-related consultations, you need to visit the **Department of Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy**.

1. **Online (Recommended):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) to book your appointment.
2. **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA/Health Care app.
3. **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital, but please bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to generate an OTP for a physical token.

### Important Information:
*   **OPD Fee:** ₹50 (payable for all booking methods).
*   **Timings:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Location:** The Dermatology OPD is located on the **Third Floor** of the New OPD building (Rooms 303 and 304).
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please carry a valid referral letter from a doctor for the Dermatology department.

*I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: How to take online appointment
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment at KGMU, you can use the following methods:

**1. Online Registration System (ORS)**
*   **Website:** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Steps:** Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "KGMU" as the hospital. Choose your required department, select an available date and time, enter the patient's details, and pay the ₹50 registration fee to download your appointment slip.

**2. ABHA/Health Care App**
*   Register using your mobile number and verify with an OTP. Follow the same flow as the ORS website to select KGMU and book your appointment.

**3. SMS Appointment**
*   Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>` to **8887019134**.

**4. Walk-in Registration**
*   You may visit the hospital in person. Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP at the counter. You will be issued a physical token to pay the ₹50 fee and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Mandatory Registration:** Online registration is mandatory for all OPD visits.
*   **Fees:** There is a ₹50 fee for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD hours are Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referrals:** Patients coming from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department they wish to visit.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.

For further assistance, you may contact the KGMU help line at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
